title: Update sorting out of starlark flags to also identify external repo starlark flags

timeline.message: update starlark options parser finding to use a regexp
timeline.author: Julie Xia
Julie Xia
Julie Xia

timeline.body: Could you also add a test for the `--@//external/starlark/option` main repo case please?

Regex-based parsing is going to fall into difficulties. Can this just strip off the -- and the no (if present), and call [LabelValidator.validateAbsoluteLabel](https://cs.opensource.google/bazel/bazel/+/master:src/main/java/com/google/devtools/build/lib/cmdline/LabelValidator.java;drc=61d663a503710c8cb0d03d18f2eb776981b49e17;l=227), and check for exceptions being thrown?

timeline.author: Julie Xia

timeline.body: This logic is great, but needs comments. More comments.

reply.body: Done! added a description to the javadoc as well
